topic: Khitpit season 2 Coming soon only on tarang plus
caption:
Getting the friction right in everyday comedy is a tightrope walk. 

With *Khitpit*, the magic is in those tiny, domestic arguments we all secretly live through. We are currently sharpening the cuts and timing in the edit room for Season 2. 

It’s going to be pettier, louder, and way closer to home. 

Coming soon, only on Tarang Plus.

#KhitpitSeason2 #TarangPlus #OdiaWebSeries #OdiaOTT
